name: weak-engagement
description: Clean site (Ledgerly) rebuilt so a visitor who arrives cannot orient or act: no viewport meta and no lang on any page, no navigation landmark (page links sit in the footer), no call to action on any key page, a fixed newsletter overlay with 60 words before the home heading, a two-word home heading followed by 130 words that never say what the product is, no trust signals (no testimonials, security, prices or terms/privacy links on home/about/contact), a dead link to /old-pricing, and a catch-all that answers 200 for unknown paths (soft 404). Discoverability signals stay intact.

expected.notes: viewport_missing is high (all six pages, blast radius to the registered maximum). hero_unclear fires with two signals (h1 'Welcome friends' is two words; the 120 words after it contain no saas noun and no verb of offer) so confidence is medium. cta_missing on every key page (home, pricing, product, about, contact): the header has only the search form (role=search never counts) and the contact page's sales mailto is not in the saas vocabulary. landmark_missing on home (no nav, no role=navigation, header list has no links). broken_sampled: /old-pricing (explicit 404 route) linked from the home body. lang_missing on home. soft_404: the '*' route serves the home page with 200; unhelpful_404 is then not_evaluated with reason soft_404. interstitial: #welcome-modal, position:fixed, 60 words, before the h1. trust: none of testimonials/logos, a security or compliance link, a price on home/about/contact or the pricing page, or terms/privacy links. continuity on home only ('Welcome friends' shares nothing with the title or description). Breadcrumbs, search, related links and page weight stay green. pricing_or_trial is present (free plan / contact sales), so fx.facts.key_fact_missing passes.
